title: Evidence Event
description: One immutable measurement signal in the Learner Record Store (append-only). Every quiz, task, peer review, live session, gate viva, and diagnostic emits one or more of these. This log IS the audit trail, the analytics source, and the composite input.

source.description: Emitting agent/service, e.g. trainer, examiner, peer_mentor, live_session_tracker, diagnostic.

competency_id.description: Stable id from competency-framework.yaml, e.g. L1.GENAI.PROMPTING.

modality.description: async = cheatable (quiz/task); sync = live viva. Drives the integrity delta.

weight_hint.description: Optional per-event weight override for rollup.

model.description: e.g. the resolved model id, when type=llm.

justification.description: Required for summative; stored for appeal.

framework_version.description: competency-framework.yaml version at scoring time — makes the score reproducible.

calibration_id.description: Which calibration run validated this rubric version (summative).

mismatch_delta.description: async_score - sync_score for this competency (positive = suspicious).

evidence_refs.description: Links to submission/media in object store — a human can always re-check.
